description: This file defines the CountryDao interface, which extends a generic DAO interface for CRUD operations on Country entities and includes a method to list countries by language.

classes.name: CountryDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to Country entities, extending generic DAO with additional method to fetch countries by language.

methods.name: listByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Country entities associated with a specific Language.
